Bot: I guess I’m just a natural.
Lady Annalie: This is pretty fun when you are not struggling for your life.
#bot.Expression.veryhappy
Bot: I know, right?!
#bot.Expression.happy
Lady Annalie: It’s fun hanging out with you two. I will miss it.
Bot: What do you mean?
#bot.Expression.clear
Lady Annalie: Your boy told me that you two are planning on moving away.
Bot: W-Well, it’s nothing set in stone yet. Because of certain special circumstances moving away to a place like Paradisium would mean a lot for us.
#Annalie_Outside.face.sad
Lady Annalie: I see…
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Lady Annalie: But I guess you two could always visit me from time to time so it wouldn’t be that bad, right?
#bot.Expression.sad
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Pervy+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
Bot: Unfortunately, us coming back here would be unlikely…
Lady Annalie: …
